title: Osha
subtitle: Haunted By Her Past
text: Action [Exhaust]: If a friendly Heroism unit was defeated this phase, play a Villainy unit from your resources, ignoring its Villainy aspect penalties. If you do, you may resource a card from your hand.
deployBox:
Saboteur
Action: Play a Villainy unit from your resources, ignoring its Villainy aspect penalties. If you do, you may resource a card from your hand.
epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 6 or more resources, deploy this leader.
rules:
Osha’s leader ability still can be used as an action even if no friendly Heroism units were defeated this phase (but you don't get to play a card).
Resources enter play exhausted.
Osha's action ability cannot be used as an action if you don't play a unit, as it would not change the game state.
